context: Asuka leads a discussion comparing two essays.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: seminar discussion; analytical connectives (つつ/そこで/その他/なし/最も) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 二つの文章を、比べてみましょう。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最初の文章は、根拠なしに見えます。
lines.en: The first essay seems to lack grounds.
lines.style: analytical young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 根拠なしの主張は、弱くなります。
lines.en: A claim without grounds becomes weak.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 二つ目は、最も論理的ですね。
lines.en: The second is the most logical.
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 事実を示しつつ、感情にも訴えています。
lines.en: It shows facts while appealing to emotion.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: その他の点では、どうでしょうか?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そこで、構成の違いに注目しましょう。
lines.en: So, let's focus on the difference in structure.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最も大切なのは、流れなんですね。
lines.en: What matters most is the flow.
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm realization throughout
